SELECT `product_id`
FROM `example-catalog`.`parity_shop`.`products`
TABLESAMPLE (100.0 PERCENT) REPEATABLE (7)
WHERE `product_id` IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY xxhash64(7, `product_id`), `product_id`
LIMIT 10000

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT pos AS __KUMO_BATCH__, col.id AS __KUMO_ID__, col.e AS __KUMO_END_TIME__, col.s AS __KUMO_START_TIME__
  FROM posexplode(from_json(?, 'array<struct<id:bigint,e:string,s:string>>'))
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__ as __KUMO_BATCH__, `quantity`, `ordered_at`
FROM TMP
JOIN `example-catalog`.`parity_shop`.`orders`
  ON `product_id` = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
 AND `ordered_at` <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
AND `ordered_at` > TMP.__KUMO_START_TIME__
WHERE `ordered_at` <= ?
AND `ordered_at` > ?
ORDER BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, `ordered_at`, `order_id`, `product_id`, `quantity`, `user_id`

SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__ as __KUMO_BATCH__, `order_id`, `user_id`, `product_id`, `quantity`, `ordered_at`
FROM TMP
JOIN `example-catalog`.`parity_shop`.`orders`

 AND `ordered_at` <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
 AND `ordered_at` > TMP.__KUMO_START_TIME__
WHERE `ordered_at` <= ?
  AND `ordered_at` > ?
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
  PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__
  ORDER BY `ordered_at` DESC, `order_id`, `product_id`, `quantity`, `user_id`
) <= 32
ORDER BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, `ordered_at` DESC, `order_id`, `product_id`, `quantity`, `user_id`
